newsitem.title: USA: Laser Vision says May procedure volume up.
newsitem.headline: Laser Vision says May procedure volume up.

text.p: Laser Vision Centers Inc on Thursday said it performed 32 percent more U.S. excimer laser procedures to correct nearsightedness in May than it did in the previous month.

Laser Vision said it decided to issue a statement on its case volume after VISX Inc, which makes excimer laser systems for eye surgery, warned that its results in the second quarter and fiscal year 1997 would fall short of expectations.
But Laser Vision said excimer laser case volume was ahead of expectations.
"We are experiencing tremendous growth, not only from our mobile laser programs, but in our fixed centers as well," said Laser Vision Chairman and Chief Executive John Klobnak.
Klobnak said the company expected to require additional excimer laser equipment much sooner than its business plan had projected.

"We are looking at a variety of options to obtain additional equipment," said Klobnak. He said while many surgeons may be on the sidelines waiting to acquire laser systems, there has been an obvious increase in interest in surgeons wanting access to lasers.
